title: Botswana calculator readiness research — Batch 38

findings.detail: Two government-reported totals conflict: 117,228.42 MT in the 12 Aug 2025 government release and 137,876.84 MT in the 30 Oct 2025 Ministry spokesperson report. Neither is selected as the accepted value.
The later Ministry report gives planted area for maize (74,139.87 ha) and sorghum (39,568.28 ha), but no matching harvested area and crop-specific production table. No yield is calculated.
Preliminary 2025 census figures report 1,638,543 cattle, 1,271,407 goats and 323,279 sheep. BOPA reports the results are preliminary and subject to revision.

Government portal lists 31 local authority councils. These are added as selector lookup labels, not asserted to be the same as the 28 administrative districts or 29 agricultural census districts. A crosswalk is still required.

BAMB official producer/contract price portal identified; the current primary price file and full grade/eligibility terms have not yet been extracted. Secondary January 2026 figures remain unverified and are not admitted as calculator prices.
No validated regional crop or livestock gross-margin budget; farmer-paid input, labour, water, machinery and transport costs remain outstanding.

sources.title: Government of Botswana local authorities and councils

safeguards: No numeric Botswana crop yield, price, cost or margin activated.
Existing ten active country profiles left unchanged.
